cases.description: When enableSchemaCache is false the method should bypass the cache and return the schema produced by getMappedSchema directly.
When enableSchemaCache is false and getMappedSchema returns null, loadSchema must propagate the null result.

group: Cache enabled – cache miss, mapping succeeds

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned from getMappedSchema.withConfig(config) and stored in cache
cases.description: First call with a fresh URI while caching is enabled should invoke getMappedSchema, store the non‑null schema in the cache and return the result of schema.withConfig(config).

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned from cachedSchema.withConfig(config) (getMappedSchema not called again)
cases.description: A second call with the same URI should hit the cache, skip getMappedSchema, and still invoke withConfig on the cached schema.

group: Cache enabled – cache miss, mapping returns null

cases.expected: null and cache remains empty for this URI
cases.description: When enableSchemaCache is true but getMappedSchema returns null, loadSchema must return null and must not place a null entry into the cache.

Simulate a race where the cache is checked twice (outside and inside the synchronized block). The test verifies that the second check does not affect the result and that the schema is stored exactly once.

group: Cache enabled – cache hit with different config

cases.expected: First call returns schema from getMappedSchema.withConfig(configA) and stores it; second call with a different config returns cachedSchema.withConfig(configB) (getMappedSchema not invoked again).
cases.description: Populate the cache with a schema using config A, then call loadSchema again with the same URI but a different config B. Verify that the method does not call getMappedSchema a second time and that the returned schema is the cached instance after applying withConfig(configB).

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned from cachedSchema.withConfig(null) (no NullPointerException).
cases.description: When caching is enabled and the supplied SchemaValidatorsConfig is null, loadSchema should still return a JsonSchema (the cached one) after invoking withConfig(null). This checks that the method tolerates a null config argument.

cases.expected: NullPointerException thrown (schemaUri is required for getMappedSchema).
cases.description: When caching is disabled and a null SchemaLocation is passed, the method should propagate the NPE that occurs inside getMappedSchema (or earlier). This validates argument validation for the URI parameter.

cases.expected: JsonSchema instance returned from pre‑populated cachedSchema.withConfig(config) without invoking getMappedSchema.
cases.description: Manually insert a JsonSchema into the factory's internal cache before invoking loadSchema. Verify that loadSchema returns the cached schema after applying withConfig and never calls getMappedSchema.

group: Cache enabled – getMappedSchema returns null after a previous successful mapping

cases.expected: First call returns a JsonSchema (stored in cache). Second call returns the same JsonSchema (cached) even though getMappedSchema would now return null.
cases.description: Simulate a scenario where the first invocation maps the URI successfully and caches it, then alter the underlying loader so that subsequent getMappedSchema calls would return null. The second loadSchema call must still return the cached schema, proving that the cache shields later mapping failures.
When caching is enabled and the supplied SchemaLocation is null, ConcurrentHashMap.get(null) throws NullPointerException before any call to getMappedSchema. The method must propagate this exception.

group: Cache enabled – getMappedSchema returns null (NPE on withConfig)

cases.description: With caching enabled, if getMappedSchema returns null, loadSchema attempts to invoke withConfig on a null reference, causing a NullPointerException. The test verifies that this exception is thrown.

group: Cache enabled – getMappedSchema throws unchecked exception

cases.description: Simulate a scenario where getMappedSchema throws an unchecked IllegalStateException (e.g., due to I/O failure). loadSchema should not catch it and must let the exception propagate.

group: Cache disabled – getMappedSchema throws unchecked exception

cases.description: When caching is disabled, loadSchema directly returns the result of getMappedSchema. If getMappedSchema throws an unchecked IllegalArgumentException, the method must propagate it unchanged.
